newsitem.title: USA: Wired Ventures in search for new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Wired Ventures in search for new CEO.

text.p: Wired Ventures Inc said Thursday it is seeking a new chief executive to succeed its co-founder Louis Rossetto.
Rossetto would remain as chairman of the board, the company said.

"Wired Ventures continues to realize impressive revenue growth, up 36 percent for the first half of this year as compared to the same period last year," Rossetto said in a statement. "Now it's time to take the entire company to the next level."'
Rossetto also is to continue as editor and publisher of Wired magazine, as well as chief creative officer and director of new product development.

Wired Ventures has retained the San Francisco office of the executive search firm, Heidrick and Struggles. Rossetto and the board's search committee will be actively involved in recruiting the new chief executive, the company said.
